content.text:
Yes, this is really common at 20 months. Night wakings often show up around now with teething, a nap shift, or a burst of new skills like language.

Tonight, keep the 2am visit short and boring. Go in, use a low calm voice, give a quick pat or a few words, and leave the lights off. Skip the feed, the play and the carry downstairs, so 2am doesn't turn into a new routine.

If they seem sick or in pain, or this comes with a fever, call Health811 at 811 any time. Call 911 if it's an emergency.
